name: card
description: A labeled card with a title, optional details and an optional collapse control. Each fact label and its value align on the baseline. In a thread, the card uses a subtle surface. If the author is the message actor, the visible line is shorter and a screen reader reads the full author.

parts.name: authorship
parts.description: Type and ID of the author, with a name when available.

parts.name: body
parts.description: Content that shows when the card is expanded.

parts.name: collapsed-summary
parts.description: Short text that shows when the card is collapsed.

parts.name: details
parts.description: Control and technical details of a refusal.

parts.name: provenance
parts.description: Group that shows the author and the source.

parts.name: reason
parts.description: Reason for a refusal or an edit error.

parts.name: toggle
parts.description: Button with a chevron that expands or collapses the card. It keeps its name and expanded state in text display.

parts.name: tooltip
parts.description: Name of the icon control on hover or focus. Escape closes it.
